text:
laura: Quick FYI — release cutoff in ~6 hours (16:00 PT). Please add changelog entries and PR links. Use the release notes template. If you need a version-bump PR, assign @matt.

matt: On it — will open bump PR for 0.9.3 -> 0.9.4 shortly. @olivia can you confirm backport for the dedicated docs?

olivia: Yup, I will backport docs to `release/0.9.x` and add a short entry under Docs.

sophia: Quick Q — what's the canonical changelog entry shape? single sentence + tag?

laura: Yep. Keep it one short line, start with a dash, tag the component. Example: 
```
- API: Add streaming support for chunked responses (PR #1234) — improves latency for long responses.
```
If cross-cutting, include bracketed tag like `[API]` or `[DevEx]`. Include a PR link if available.

adam: Also please add the `area:` label on the PR so the release script picks it up. If you forget, ping me and I'll add it.

ci-bot: Automated reminder — changelog lint runs at cutoff. Entries must start with `-` and include a PR reference or issue. Failures will block the release job.

deploy-bot: Merge window closes at 16:00 PT. Hotfixes after cutoff require eng-oncall approval and a quick post-merge audit.

matt: PR opened -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/bumps/567 (assigning @laura for quick sanity check).

sophia: Added changelog entry under `Unreleased` and linked the PR. Paste here if you want a phrasing tweak.

laura: Helpful checklist (copy/paste):
- add `-` entry in `docs/CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased
- include component tag and PR link
- add `area:` label on PR
- open/version-bump PR if applicable
- request reviewers (assign @matt for bump)

adam: If you can't get reviewers pre-cutoff, add `release/hold` label and we'll triage after cutoff.

olivia: Small nit — reference the template: https://go.redwood/release-template (it's got examples for docs, API, infra).

sophia: pasted entry for quick edit: 
```
- DevEx: Enforce changelog entry lint in CI (PR #2345) — prevents malformed release notes.
```

laura: LGTM :thumbsup:

matt: I'll merge the bump once CI is green and changelog lint is happy.

laura: Thanks all — appreciate quick turn on this. If anyone needs help with phrasing drop it here and I'll edit.
